question: When the shared technology prompt chooses research for a nonlocal player, which positions of its eligible list does the scoring loop visit, and is Alphabet skipped when it is the first eligible technology?

scope.boundary: The nonlocal branch of the shared prompt 0x82CECCD8: list construction, the scan start, the scoring loop and the numeric type 4 submission. The shared eligibility predicate 0x82CE2C50 and its optional prerequisite check 0x82CE2280 are read only for Alphabet. The grant scan 0x82D20C9C to 0x82CED640 is excluded as a different operation. Other research selection paths, modified definitions and any natural AI choice are outside this bound.

dependencies.use: The turn-start check 0x82D1D604 is the only automatic caller that reaches the prompt for a player without a command.
The shared eligibility predicate 0x82CE2C50 as used by the starting grant loop.
Completion of a selected technology is a separate path from the selection that this finding covers.

currentEvidence.method: Foreground read-only Ghidra word queries of the pinned image and narrow generated-code corroboration of the exact instructions. Static evidence only; no runtime observation of an AI research choice.

entries.role: scoring scan start: pointer set to the list base plus 4
scoring loop advance and numeric type 4 submission
command writer that stores the type 4 payload

currentEvidence.qualification: The list layout, the scan start and the loop count are read directly from the instructions. That the traversal skips the first entry is a static consequence of them. No natural AI choice was observed, so the defect is a candidate.

eligibleList.construction: The nonlocal branch builds the eligible technology IDs in ascending order, appends the sentinel -1 at ordinal N and retains N + 1 as the list size.
eligibleList.emptyList: When N is 0 the retained size is 1, and the branch skips scoring before the loop. This is the existing no-candidate path.

scoringTraversal.start: At 0x82CED340 the scan pointer is set to the list base plus 4, which is ordinal 1.
scoringTraversal.count: The loop runs N iterations, one decrement and a pointer advance of 4 per iteration at 0x82CED610.
scoringTraversal.visited: Ordinals 1 through N: the first real technology (ordinal 0) is never scored and the sentinel -1 at ordinal N is visited.
scoringTraversal.submission: The result is submitted as a numeric type 4 value at 0x82CED61C..0x82CED62C. The command writer 0x82CDFFB0 stores that payload in 0x830EDD48[player].

cases.visitedNow: ordinals 1 and 2, the second technology and the sentinel

scoringTraversal.checkedRealCandidateCounts: Offline counts N = 1 through 47 gave the visited range 1..N now and 0..N-1 after the proposed correction.

alphabetEligibility.definition: Alphabet is technology 1. Its three prerequisite halfwords and its blocker field are all -1.
alphabetEligibility.predicate: With the inspected definitions, 0x82CE2C50 accepts it when the initial ownership query returns zero. The optional prerequisite check 0x82CE2280 returns zero for Alphabet and does not exclude it.
alphabetEligibility.costCheck: A root technology whose prerequisite values are all -1 bypasses the general prerequisite cost limit.
alphabetEligibility.firstEntry: Alphabet is the first real entry whenever it is unowned, eligible and technology 0 is not on the list. In that case the scan start skips it on every choice until the player gets it by another route.
alphabetEligibility.qualification: That every AI path calls the predicate is not shown. A static cause is identified, not an intentionally low Alphabet score.

excludedEdge.result: A technology grant scan over IDs 0 through 47 that can acquire with source 6 and phase 1. It contains no store to the selected research slot, so it is not research selection.

callerReach.caller: 0x82D1D1C0 calls the shared prompt at 0x82D1D604 for a nonlocal player, bypassing the local interface dispatch.
callerReach.requires: The research slot unset or invalid, the state bit clear and the resolver and player inputs retained.
callerReach.humanMask: In the inspected suffix a nonzero human mask with the player's bit clear reaches the scorer after 0x82D8AA60, subject to a normal return. A zero mask uses a session helper instead.
callerReach.qualification: Being nonlocal does not by itself prove the player is an AI.

candidateCorrection.start: Begin the scan at the first real entry (ordinal 0).
candidateCorrection.preserve: Keep the real candidate count and the empty-list path.
candidateCorrection.include: Every eligible ID exactly once, and never the sentinel -1.
candidateCorrection.doNotUse: Forcing Alphabet ownership or tuning its cost does not correct the enumeration.

openConditions: No natural choice by an AI player with Alphabet unowned was observed, so the traversal result is not corroborated at runtime.
Whether the branch is delivered for every AI player, the effect of a modified definition table and any other research selection path are separate questions.
What the scorer does when the sentinel -1 is visited and chosen is not established here.
guards: Do not describe the list traversal as an intended low score for Alphabet.
Do not treat the grant scan 0x82D20C9C to 0x82CED640 as research selection.
Do not infer that a nonlocal player is an AI from the branch alone.
Static evidence only; no completed AI research choice or runtime outcome follows.
conclusion: On the nonlocal branch of the shared prompt, the scoring loop starts at ordinal 1 of the eligible list and runs N iterations, so it skips the first eligible technology and visits the sentinel. Alphabet, an eligible root technology, is skipped whenever it is first on the list. This is a candidate defect from static evidence.
